title: Recall: Branch on optional values without panics
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

double.clue: Given input: Option<u32>, write an if-let expression binding the present payload as value and returning value * 2, otherwise the integer 0.

early.clue: Inside fn width(input: Option<&str>) -> usize, write the complete let-else statement binding text and returning 0 for absence. Include the terminating semicolon.
